items.question: Is my data GDPR compliant?
items.answer: Yes. Prismconnex is designed with GDPR in mind, with privacy-by-design principles and built-in suppression workflows.

items.question: How does deliverability monitoring work?
items.answer: We monitor SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication for your sending domains and surface reputation signals in the deliverability dashboard.

items.question: What is data lineage transparency?
items.answer: Every record shows its source, fetched date, and confidence score so your team can judge quality before acting.

items.question: Can I switch plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time, and changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.
